changelog:
novel2voice v2.19.1 is a new skill for converting novels or subtitles into multi-character audiobooks with advanced TTS features.

- Converts novel text or subtitle files (.srt/.ass) into multi-character, emotionally nuanced audiobooks.
- Supports Edge TTS (500+ voices, default, free) and MiMo TTS (requires API key) backends.
- Automatically detects roles, assigns voices/styles, and handles emotions and dialects.
- Includes step-by-step onboarding for first-time users, with environment checks and voice selection guides.
- Robust error handling, environment preflight checks, and safety guardrails in processing.
- Input can be pasted text or files; supports large projects via batching and resume functions.
